# M3 · Same-reference convergence monitor: results

**Run:** 23 Oct 2026 on the snapshot (data through 22 Oct 2026). All numbers come from `m3_tables.md`, regenerated by `python "PS Research/m3_convergence/summarise_m3.py"`. The method is in `tola/convergence.py`; the outputs are the five `data/snapshot/convergence_*.parquet` tables.

## What the monitor does

It compares contracts with the **same expiry**, per gram at 999, on the same day. The premium is `1e4 × (small / big − 1)` on the day's VWAP, with the close as a cross-check.

| Pair | Why |
|---|---|
| GOLDGUINEA / GOLDTEN | Same settlement price (Ahmedabad poll). Any premium must vanish at settlement. |
| GOLDPETAL / GOLDTEN | Same rule, but GOLDPETAL settles to the Mumbai poll. The premium should converge to the Mumbai–Ahmedabad gap. |
| GOLDPETAL / GOLDGUINEA | Context back to 2020, before GOLDTEN existed |
| GOLD / GOLDM | **Control.** Both 995, both settle on the same 3-day average. They share expiries on even months only. |

- **Eligible day:** both legs traded ₹1 Cr+ and neither is in its tender window. The window comes from each contract's own spec version: 5 days before Nov/Dec 2025, 3 days after.
- **Cycle:** counts when it has 10+ eligible days.
- **Pooled numbers:** cover expired cycles only, with a cycle-bootstrap 95% CI (the G0 method).
- **Live cycles:** ranked against expired cycles of the same pair at the same days-to-expiry stage.

## Findings

**1. Every expired cycle shows the premium, and the numbers match G0.**

| Pair | Cycles | Pooled premium | 95% CI | Cycles positive |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GOLDGUINEA / GOLDTEN | 18 (Apr 2025 – Sep 2026) | **+78.7 bp** | [61, 97] | 18 / 18 |
| GOLDPETAL / GOLDTEN | 18 | **+94.2 bp** | [80, 109] | 18 / 18 |

The close-based figures agree within 0.4 bp. G0's numbers (+78.7 and +94.1) were computed with a fixed 5-day tender exclusion. The monitor uses the spec's actual window and lands in the same place.

**2. The premium doesn't converge before settlement; settlement removes it in one step.**

| Days to expiry | 60+ | 40–59 | 20–39 | 10–19 | 5–9 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GOLDGUINEA / GOLDTEN | 87 | 78 | 69 | 68 | 76 |
| GOLDPETAL / GOLDTEN | 97 | 96 | 88 | 85 | 91 |

At settlement, GOLDGUINEA and GOLDTEN land on the same price per gram (median gap 0.01 bp, never more than 0.11 bp). GOLDPETAL lands at its Mumbai gap (median −3.8 bp). So **a holder into settlement gives up the whole premium in one step**: on average **68 bp (₹95/g) for GOLDGUINEA and 95 bp (₹133/g) for GOLDPETAL**, measured from the last pre-tender day.

*The 0–4 day bucket (+100 and +112 bp) only has data from the 10 cycles under the 3-day tender window. All of them are Dec 2025 or later, in the high-premium regime. It reflects which cycles are in that bucket, not a jump at the end of each cycle (CI 53–177 bp).*

**3. GOLDPETAL's settlement carries timing risk.** On **30 Jan 2026** (the crash day), Mumbai polled GOLDPETAL's spot at 18:39. Ahmedabad polled GOLDTEN and GOLDGUINEA at 17:43, and gold kept falling in between. GOLDPETAL settled **166 bp below** the other two. Its usual gap is −4 bp. The spec's "polled around 5 pm" leaves room for this.

**4. The control pair was flat for six years, then GOLD (1 kg) went cheap to GOLDM (100 g).**

| Period | Cycles | GOLD / GOLDM | 95% CI | Positive |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2020–2025 | 35 | **−0.7 bp** | [−2.4, +1.1] | 51% |
| 2026 | 4 | **−9.5 bp** | [−12.6, −6.6] | 0 of 4 |

The live 2027 contracts sit at −10 bp (Feb) and −35 bp (Apr). The same "smaller lot trades richer" pattern now shows one step up the size ladder, between the two big contracts. That's only four expired cycles, so treat it as an early signal, but it matches M2: GOLD's residual was −4.7 bp and GOLDM's +4.1 bp in 2026.

**5. Today (22 Oct 2026) the premium is well below the 2026 average.**

| Pair | Six live expiries (Oct 2026 – Mar 2027) | Rank vs expired cycles at the same stage |
|---|---|---|
| GOLDGUINEA / GOLDTEN | **+32 to +45 bp** | 19th–44th percentile |
| GOLDPETAL / GOLDTEN | **+24 to +49 bp** | 0–20th percentile |
| GOLDPETAL / GOLDGUINEA | −19 to +4 bp | (since Apr 2025) |

In calendar time (monthly median of eligible days), the premium peaked in **Jan–Mar 2026 at 160–200 bp**. That was the same window in which M2 found carry at 13–17%. It collapsed in **April 2026 (54 and 76 bp)** and has ranged **36–76 bp** since. October's 42–43 bp sits near the low end of that range: about a quarter of the peak. GOLDPETAL has fallen back to GOLDGUINEA's level.

| Monthly median | Jan–Mar 2026 | Apr | May | Jun | Jul | Aug | Sep | Oct |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GOLDGUINEA / GOLDTEN | 160–180 | 54 | 36 | 64 | 70 | 53 | 56 | 43 |
| GOLDPETAL / GOLDTEN | 170–199 | 76 | 62 | 72 | 73 | 54 | 50 | 42 |

**6. In the longer history, GOLDPETAL was cheap.** GOLDPETAL vs GOLDGUINEA averaged −35 to −213 bp a year from 2020 to 2024 (−70 bp pooled over 81 cycles; only 25% positive). It has been about 0 since the Apr 2025 contract (−5 and +5 bp in 2025 and 2026). M1 and M2 found the same break.

## What this means for the build

- **M4 (walk-forward):** the premium doesn't fade before the tender window, so a "buy small, sell big, exit before tender" rule only earns what the premium happens to drift. Expect a null result. The full premium is capturable only by holding through settlement with physical delivery, as G0 said. Test that leg explicitly.
- **M5 (chooser):** a trader who exits before tender pays the *change* in premium over their holding period. One who takes delivery pays the entry premium in full (finding 2), plus the making charge (M2). At today's 30–50 bp (finding 5), small-lot entry costs about a quarter of what it did in Jan–Mar 2026.
- **Alert log:** `convergence_live` already has the inputs: percentile vs history, 5-day change, eligibility. Candidate quiet-by-default triggers are a percentile outside 10–90%, a 5-day move above 15 bp, or the control pair moving away from zero.
- **The app's Convergence page:** the profile chart (`convergence_profile`), per-cycle paths (`convergence_daily`) and the live table (`convergence_live`).

## Limits

- **18 same-reference cycles.** GOLDTEN only listed in Apr 2025.
- **The control finding rests on 4 expired 2026 cycles.**
- **Premiums use daily VWAP and closes**, not intraday quotes or fills.
- **The settlement prices are rebuilt from polls** (verified against MCX's published values only up to Sep 2023; see M1).
